why: A record of a walk of the BLOCKOUT, standing beside the detailed build. The grid, ways and blockout hashes are this point's own, so the grid and the ways compare equal and nothing but the detail half can be what refuses it; the `detail_sha256` is the hash of a build that binds no place, which is what every walk taken before detail names. The owner walks the world that ships, with its real buildings and materials, after detail — a blockout somebody stood in tells them almost nothing — so a record of the blockout is not a walk of this build, and it must not be able to stand in for one: left beside a detailed build it would let that build ship on a walk of something else. It declares no unit: every field these documents use is written in the site-plan overlay and compiles there, so there is nothing to exempt — what must not compile is a record of the blockout standing beside a detailed build.
